movements.name: Hear / Recognise
movements.prompt_for: User describes a fresh impression, a verse that struck them, a sense of being spoken to.

movements.name: Discern
movements.short: Wisdom about the source and shape of what is heard.
movements.prompt_for: User is uncertain whether something is from God, from themselves, or from another voice.

movements.name: Test / Weigh
movements.short: Measure what is heard against Scripture and witness.
movements.prompt_for: User is checking a word against the canon — does it square with the whole of Scripture?

movements.name: Record
movements.short: Capture the testimony before it fades.
movements.prompt_for: User has just received something and needs to write it down before it slips away.

movements.name: Remember
movements.short: Return to what was said when the road gets hard.
movements.prompt_for: User has forgotten, is in a fog, needs to be reminded of what God has spoken before.

movements.name: Engage
movements.short: Act on it, live into it.
movements.prompt_for: User is asking how to live out what they have heard — the next concrete step.

movements.name: Trust
movements.short: Lean on it when nothing else is solid.
movements.prompt_for: User is anxious, afraid, in the dark — needs to rest on what they have already received.

movements.name: Fight the good fight
movements.prompt_for: User is in a season of resistance, opposition, spiritual battle — needs to hold ground.

movements.name: Endure / Persevere
movements.prompt_for: User is exhausted, tempted to give up, long road wearing them down.

structuredContent.north_star: Encouragement for your whole journey. The next mile, not the next step.
